summary: This document outlines a planned 2026 Balkan travel itinerary, offering two transportation options: driving from Northern Europe or using cross-border buses. The route covers major cities in Serbia, Bosnia, Croatia, Montenegro, Albania, Greece, Bulgaria, and Romania, including detailed schedules, accommodation recommendations in Shkoder, and logistical tips for cross-border travel.
